requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Syntactic ambiguity regarding the phrase 'enters the access card with the access code' was resolved by business rule BR-01. The supported interpretation establishes a sequential action: first inserting the card, then entering the code. Structured as a single functional requirement reflecting the resolved sequence.

source_fragments: The user enters the access card with the access code.

fields.condition: the user performs the access procedure
fields.action: insert the access card into the card reader and enter the access code on the keypad
fields.object: the access card and the access code

structured_requirements.final_statement: The user shall insert the access card into the card reader and then enter the access code on the keypad.
structuring_notes: Resolved syntactic ambiguity using business rule BR-01. The phrase 'with the access code' was interpreted as describing the second action (entering the code) rather than the instrument for the first action (inserting the card).

unsupported_inferences_avoided: Did not assume specific timing between insertion and code entry beyond the sequential order defined in BR-01.
